newsitem.title: UK: Deutsche MG leads 224 mln stg mortgage-backed bond.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche MG leads 224 mln stg mortgage-backed bond.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Monday it was lead manager of a 223.9 million stg four-tranche mortgage-backed issue launched in the name of Finance for People (No.1) Plc.
There are 67 million stg of of Class A1 fast-pay notes with an average life of 1.1 years and reoffered at three-month LIBOR plus six basis points.
There are 128.78 million stg of of Class A2 slow-pay notes with an average life of 4.9 years and reoffered at three-month LIBOR plus 13 b.p.
There are 16.92 million stg of of Class B notes with an average life of 5.9 years and reoffered at three-month LIBOR plus 35 b.p.
There are 11.29 million stg of of Class C notes with an average life of 5.9 years and reoffered at three-month LIBOR plus 69 b.p.
